candidates.sentence: We must remain at the forefront of legal immigration reform that will boost the American economy.

As we go forward with solutions, I believe we need to focus on incremental program changes for future recipients now aged 55 and under, ensuring benefits will be available to them when they reach enrollment age while keeping the promise to those currently relying on retirement income and Medicare coverage.
I will continue to champion Christian pro-life values and work towards a future where every individual's right to life is safeguarded and celebrated.
We must secure our borders by immediately building a physical wall along our Southern border and hiring additional Border Patrol agents.
As such, we must act to defund sanctuary cities immediately and fix what has become a national security crisis.
I am committed to defending the Second Amendment against any attempts to diminish it.
I am committed to advancing policies that promote a culture of life, supporting measures that protect the rights of the unborn, and providing resources to empower women facing unplanned pregnancies.
Through compassionate and comprehensive support systems, we can promote alternatives to abortion, fostering a society where life is respected and protected.
I believe in increasing price transparency and fostering competition to lower health care costs and prescription drug prices.
